◆ Introduction ◆
Amidst a fierce battle of ninety-nine fighters, only the victor can seize air superiority... Customize your ultimate fighter, devise winning strategies, and break through the endless bullet hell to emerge victorious!

◆ Event Rules ◆
● The event is divided into two modes: "Path to Ascension" and "Playoffs."
● "Path to Ascension" consists of four stages in total. The Trailblazer can accumulate points by participating in "Path to Ascension," and the next stage will unlock once a certain point requirement is met.
● The stages in "Path to Ascension" consist of five phases. The Trailblazer can clear the stage by defeating all enemies across the five phases.
● Clearing all stages in "Path to Ascension" will unlock the "Playoffs" mode. In the "Playoffs" mode, the Trailblazer can clear the stage by defeating all enemies across the seven phases.

◆ Gameplay Intro ◆
● At the Respite Node, the Trailblazer can select equipment for their pixel plane and deploy them.
● At the Surprise Attack Node, once deployed, the Trailblazer's pixel plane will automatically attack the enemy using equipment.

◆ Permanent Rewards ◆
● Keep participating in the tournament to accumulate Career Points and claim tournament payouts.

◆ Limited-Time Rewards ◆
● During the limited-time event, complete various gameplay goals to obtain limited-time rewards.

◆ Event Reminders ◆
● After the Pixel Plane Rumble limited-time event ends, Trailblazers will no longer be able to obtain the limited-time rewards during the event period, but they can still visit the Duomension City map to speak with Gaming Sage, experience the event, and obtain permanent rewards.
